Market today: The mood is clearly bearish on tech and AI. News of a probe into Nvidia's CEO and Citi's call to sit out the global tech trade are the main drivers, directly impacting your concentrated holdings.

Your holdings: SMH (-27.09%), SMCI (-34.46%), and especially the 3X leveraged SOXL (-79.55%) are flashing red. With margin, these deep drawdowns are amplified and need immediate attention. Many other leveraged positions are also down significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further developments regarding Nvidia's CEO and broader AI sentiment. The market is clearly reacting negatively.

Bottom line: Your heavy tech/chip concentration, especially in leveraged products, is under severe pressure; risk management is paramount.
plays: Your 3X leveraged chip bull SOXL is down almost 80%. Consider trimming or exiting this position to stop further decay and capital erosion, especially with chip sector headwinds.
SMH and SMCI are down significantly. Review your stops and consider trimming to reduce concentrated exposure to a sector facing negative news.
With tech sentiment turning negative, consider a small hedge. Scanner shows SQQQ ACCUMULATE at 47.1-46.92, stop 46.25.
